title: Expanding Mall, 1985
content: Saw a woman talking about this on tiktok, then found this reddit and I guess I'll just drop this here. When I was a kid my mom used to take me with her to the mall in a nearby city once or twice a month to go shopping, and I loved the trip when we went. When I was twelve, in 1985, I began having dreams about these trips - riding in my mom's car, walking around the place, etc. I kept having these dreams for years, and when I turned sixteen, got my driver's license and started going to this mall on my own, the dreams reflected those trips, a common theme being I'd go to this bookstore and find some really cool books to buy but would have no money, or I'd have a wallet full of cash and find nothing worth buying. Other times I'd go to the electronics store and browse or spend time in the video arcade. Things I'd do in real life. Thing is, as the years went on, the mall began expanding. Growing. It would add more and more, growing larger and more complex until after almost a decade it was a mile or two wide, at the end of it all having a large plaza of stores beside it, as well as a sprawl of buildings and features surrounding it. The video arcade grew into a large multi-level staircased room filled with machines, the food court was a massive feast of sandwiches and sweets, the bookstore became shelves and shelves of novels and old books. Outside were parking lots full of clothing stores, pizza joints, and gaming shops, as well as a pool, a colossal movie theater, an amusement park and off to the side even a nature walk of some kind that I'd visit on occasion. Going to this place was the best dreams I had as a kid/teen. So one night in my mid-20s, I'm dreaming about browsing the high-tech looking video/DVD rental store in this mall, rows and rows of movies lined up ready to rent, and I notice this blonde woman there, and she notices me and smiles. Beautiful, long blonde hair, white clothes and boots, and a white cape. I immediately thought she looked like a real life version of Celes from Final Fantasy 6. As I'm moving through the isles browsing films, we keep bumping into each other and laughing, until I hear something loud above me. Shattering glass and loud yelling noises. Men in covert ops uniforms and gear started loudly rappelling from the ceiling and invading the mall, shouting at people and ordering everyone around. A bit scared, I tried to move as far back into the rental store as I could before being pulled through an open secret doorway into the back area by the blonde woman in white, who held up her finger telling me to be quiet. She led me down a hidden corridor as we listened to black-clad soldiers loudly capturing the mall, until they discovered the passage we were taking and gave chase. We ran, the soldiers right behind us the entire time, until we came to some sort of hatch that led underground, hastily running through a labyrinth of tunnels, men in close pursuit the whole way. After a while, the angry voices got quieter and quieter until eventually they were gone, and she led me to a ladder that exited back up to the surface and a large white Cadillac convertible that was waiting for us by the highway that she ushered me into. We drove in silence for ten or fifteen minutes until she stopped again and told me to get out. She looked over and smiled at me one last time before saying, "Well kid, it's been fun, but looks like the fun's over. See ya when I see ya." Then she drove away, and I woke up. That was the summer of 1997. I was twenty-four. I never had another dream about the mall again. I really miss it.
